name: signature
title: Signature
description: A well to sign in with a finger, a pen or a mouse, or a name typed instead.
use: Consent the reader gives by signing: an agreement, a delivery, a form to authorize. The drawing goes into the form as SVG; the typed name is the keyboard's way to sign and the whole signature without a script.

instead.when: A typed name or a checkbox is all the consent needs
The reader gives a picture of a signature they already have

keyboard.action: Moves to the typed name, which signs with the keyboard, and to Undo and Clear once something is drawn. The pad itself takes no focus: a drawing has no keys
On Undo, takes back the last stroke; on Clear, takes back every stroke, as native buttons do

classes.name: signature
classes.description: The group, on a <fieldset> with a legend: the pad, its buttons, the typed name, the field a form submits and the status

classes.name: signature-readonly
classes.description: Shows the drawing as it is: nothing draws on it and Undo and Clear step aside. Make the typed name readonly too

classes.name: signature-pad
classes.description: The well the pointer draws in; it takes no touch gesture of the browser's, so a finger draws instead of scrolling

classes.name: signature-ink
classes.description: The drawing, an inline <svg> in the pad. Its viewBox sets the pad's proportions and the units of a stroke; name it as an image

classes.name: signature-stroke
classes.description: One stroke, a filled outline the script writes into the drawing

classes.name: signature-line
classes.description: The line to sign on, with a fine cross where the name begins; hide it with aria-hidden="true"

classes.name: signature-placeholder
classes.description: Words that say where to sign, shown until the first stroke; hide them with aria-hidden="true", the drawing's name says it

classes.name: signature-actions
classes.description: The row of Undo and Clear, in the pad's top corner

classes.name: signature-undo
classes.description: A button that takes back the last stroke; out of sight until there is one, and marked aria-disabled by the script while there is none

classes.name: signature-clear
classes.description: A button that takes back every stroke; out of sight until there is one, and marked aria-disabled by the script while there is none

classes.name: signature-name
classes.description: The typed name, on an input with the input class, set in a script face. Give it a visible label

classes.name: signature-value
classes.description: The field a form submits: the drawing as an SVG document, written by the script. Give it a name

classes.name: signature-status
classes.description: Clipped out of sight: what the script says when the pad is signed or emptied, for assistive technology

states.name: disabled
states.description: The fieldset is disabled: nothing draws, the ink and the words turn to disabled ink, and the fieldset disables its buttons and the typed name

states.name: invalid
states.description: The signature is missing or refused: the field and the pad take the danger contour. Say why under the field and point to it with aria-describedby

states.name: required
states.description: Required and empty once the reader tried to submit: the field and the pad take the danger contour. The script lifts required while there is a drawing

properties.name: --signature-weight
properties.description: The width of a stroke at an even pressure, in the units of the drawing's viewBox; the script reads it when it writes a stroke

properties.name: --signature-font
properties.description: The script face the typed name is set in
